payload.posture: Read John 8:39–47 as one movement in Satan's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states the scene disputes descent from Abraham, attempted killing, and true fatherhood. It also names desire, murder, truth, lies, hearing, and belonging. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Satan's story.
